scope: Add generated AC1021 source-frame coverage for valid unique-owner and malformed cross-block shared-child POLYLINE ownership preflight.

method.kind: Focused in-memory source-frame regression using production entity encoders
method.commitLimitation: Repository .git metadata is read-only in this environment; no stage or commit was attempted.

implementation.positiveControl: A single block owner claims one generated 3D POLYLINE with one VERTEX and one SEQEND; preflight accepts it and retains all three source frames without recording a failure.
implementation.negativeControl: Two distinct block records claim different 3D POLYLINE parents that reference the same VERTEX handle and have distinct SEQENDs.
negativeAssertions: Preflight rejects the cross-block shared-child graph.
Both parent handles are recorded as invalid.
Both parent frames, the shared VERTEX frame, and both SEQEND frames are removed from ObjectMap.
Two Aggregate diagnostics identify POLYLINE_3D and the matching block-record owner for each parent.
implementation.frameConstruction: The test invokes existing production encoders, emits the AC1021 inline object-data and separate handle streams, patches the object-data bit boundary, and wraps the bytes in a CRC-valid in-memory object frame.
limitations: Exercises the mapped ownership-preflight function, not a complete DWG container or production block traversal.
Only the AC1021 frame profile is exercised by this new regression.
Does not test geometry semantics, cross-version behavior, or 3D support.
